request.style: English, warm male baritone solo with ethereal choir, harp, cello, flute, gentle strings, reverent and yearning mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
O God, you are my God, I seek you at dawn
My soul thirsts for you in the dry land
My body longs for you where there is no water
In the wilderness of Judah, I stand

[Pre-Chorus]
So I have gazed on you in the sanctuary
To see your power and your glory shine

[Chorus]
Your steadfast love is better than life
My lips will praise you with all my might
I will bless you as long as I live
In your name, my hands will rise

[Verse]
Your love is better than the breath of life
My lips will praise you, they will never cease
I will bless you while my days remain
In your holy name, I find my peace

[Chorus]
Your steadfast love is better than life
My lips will praise you with all my might
I will bless you as long as I live
In your name, my hands will rise

[Bridge]
My soul will be satisfied as with rich food
With joyful lips, my mouth will praise you

[Outro]
O God, you are my God, I seek you at dawn
